proof_definition.LIVE_PATH: The sequence was exercised in the connected browser, not by the final standalone Python process.
proof_definition.CAPTURED: Live controls inspected; final save or complete configuration remains unverified.
proof_definition.PROFILE: The executor exists; a captured options profile supplies this operation's precise controls.
proof_definition.API_FIRST: Use a per-location API capability receipt before browser fallback.
